requirement.evidence: No person shall engage in the business of finding dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants for a fee unless such person is a licensed broker or salesman as defined in section eighty-seven PP of chapter one hundred and twelve.
requirement.note: The card restates the licensing requirement in plainer words. The advice about not paying an unlicensed person follows from it.
